name: BBX burns 3% of its pair's balance on every transfer once a day has passed, never resetting the timer
summary: BBX's _transfer burns 3% of the BBX/USDT pair's BBX and syncs whenever a day has passed since lastBurnTime, but never updates lastBurnTime, so from one day after deployment every transfer burns from the pair. Seconds after the timer elapsed the attacker made 500 zero-value self-transfers, burning most of the pair's BBX, then sold 18.5 BBX for 11,906 USDT.
notes: The burn first became possible at 1742461853 (lastBurnTime, set at deployment, plus one day); the anchor is the first transaction after it, and no later transaction took more than 2.2 USDT from the emptied pair. Owner changes after deployment only moved a tax recipient (slot 0x9). Loss is the pair's USDT outflow; the pair's burned BBX is valued at nothing (rule 12).
